These are achieved through pattern- and correlation-based integration (SpatialGlue and joint RNAâATAC clustering, negative binomial generalised additive model (NB-GAM) spatiotemporal modelling, and RNA-based cellâcell communication with CellChat and NICHES), with the protein layer (ADT and complementary CODEX imaging) used to refine cell types and validate spatial patterns.
